reference_observations.description: George mathematical arrangement possibilities do not prove every biological arrangement occurs. Kőrösy/Bőke counts are reported samples with conjectural explanations, not a causal estimate. Lagrange material read was the referees report, not the complete original paper.

corrections.description: First pass incorrectly says Oxford. Accepted source reading identifies the forthcoming Cambridge honorary LLD offer; predicted official letter arrival is not proved receipt.
The missing underlying Darwin letter is an editorial source-status finding, not necessarily George saying that it cannot be found in his own memorandum.
Retain apparatus warning about Monthly Magazine versus Monthly Review confusion and distinguish absence from an index from absence of an article.

summary: Seven George/Charles boundary sources, all in1863–80 by their actual contents and apparatus, with no new1851–55 links. Matched prior full readings retain four actual phyllotaxy diagrams, missing drafts, second-hand statistics and limited reading stages. No new source chronology is derived from catalogue order.
